description: Async execution timeline for GPU||NPU cooperative execution

expected_timeline.graph_compute_async_entry: Submit all XDNA ops via persistent_engine_submit()
expected_timeline.submission_loop: For each supported MUL_MAT node: dequantize -> submit -> store run_handle
expected_timeline.concurrent_gpu_execution: GPU backend executes its splits in parallel
expected_timeline.synchronize_call: Wait for all pending XDNA runs via persistent_engine_wait()
expected_timeline.output_copy: Copy NPU results to tensor data buffers
expected_timeline.event_record: Signal completion event for cross-backend dependencies
expected_timeline.event_wait: Block on events from other backends (e.g., GPU)
